title: Coral and the Letters
author: Orsen Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Hartwell, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
